detail.longDescription: Checking the Actions tab repo by repo got old, so I built ctrl alt git. Every GitHub Actions run across your repos in one view. A Timeline shows a lane per repo, so a moody afternoon stands out. Insights shows whether things are getting better. It's read-only and never keeps your code. There's a Free plan for up to 10 repos. Open now with a waitlist, and I'm letting accounts in gradually. Not in the EU, EEA or UK yet. https:// ctrlaltgit.dev # BuildInPublic # GitHub # GitHubActions # DevOps
